items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1959-08-11
items.q: That's when he went and worked Butler.

ctx.x: So anyhow, he, he, he recommended him to me and I got him and he played the job. Yeah. Now Joe Oliver didn't, couldn't play no brass band music. I mean, no dance music. No dance. No dance music, but he played brass band music. And right after that, Joe Oliver began to pick up the dance music. Next thing I heard, he was able to play. That's when he went and worked Butler.
Mm-hmm. Waked out on, uh, uh, uh, town on the big avenue. Oh, he was Butler. Yeah.
